description: Daloa university sit-in on 10 Dec is reported only through a university communiqué reproduced by two outlets; it has no count, explicit student demand or independent reporting.
required_followup: Seek the original UJLoG 11 Dec communiqué and permitted contemporaneous student/local reporting; establish demand, headcount, and any continuation.

description: PresseCotedivoire body confirms school intrusions/disruption in Sassandra and a 11 Dec injury/arrest follow-up, but says a security source would not give a number. It does not establish a single public gathering, a >=50 same-place count, or a state-policy target; AfricaCoeurNews page returned 404 and AIP page remains search-only after a separate AIP anti-bot challenge.
required_followup: Find a permitted source that clarifies whether students gathered publicly, the number at one place, and whether their demand addressed a state policy/calendar; do not sum school sites.

description: KOACI reports a 7 Dec SYNADES assembly and announces a five-day strike from 23 Dec, but does not verify strike execution or assembly attendance. It reports no public rally, picket or crowd count.
required_followup: Find a permitted post-23 Dec report confirming whether the strike happened and whether any public rally or picket reached 50 simultaneously; separately assess whether the 7 Dec AGM itself was a public protest.

description: French and English searches covered student, health, education, cocoa and regional terms.
